sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on sub-limit table; exact range not fully stated)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional 'Cashless Discount' add-on introduces 20% co-pay on reimbursement claims. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, spine, cancer, etc.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Voluntary aggregate deductible (₹10k–₹3L) available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. No inbuilt restoration.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI but excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, vector-borne diseases, and several other conditions. Must exceed 3 days.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI. Outpatient and comfort treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radiosurgery, etc.) covered up to SI. Cumulative Bonus and Restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables during hospitalisation are covered as part of treatment.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium which has 15 days grace.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma, terrorism covered, no IVF/ART

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits, Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
